My sermon for the day, as I take Susans advice and try to raise
some of the points in ISAIF.

Industrial Society and its Future

How Some People Adjust

77. Not everyone in industrial-technological society suffers from
psychological problems.
  Some people even profess to be quite satisfied with society as it is.
 We now discuss some of the reasons why people differ so greatly in their
 response to modern society.

78. First, there doubtless are differences in the strength of the drive for
power.
  Individuals with a weak drive for power may have relatively little need

I geuss its obvious that we are relativly weakly driven against the
system comapred to TK, but (weep) we struggle along.

On my wall I have just put a picture of a baby in an incubater.
This is partly because I had a dream that Alien Greys do a cereomony over
their babys in the incubater, whilest normaly never engageing in such
non work activity.
The other reasen is the article that is with the picture saying how
there is increasing dilema over preserving babies with defects that
normaly would have killed them.
As medicine improves the ability to save babies the dilema worsens
as some are almost brain dead and with other terrable defects amongst
many less terrable ones.

As I see it the human race will is split in 2, those who have
medicine and those that don't.
Some say that one day we will all have access to some medicine.

But as you may know, I think the burgening caperbilities of Robots and
computers will eventually push out people from the nest of medicine access
one way or another.
So I say prepare, because you canot be sure which side of the nest wall
your desendants will be on with the burgeoning of Robotic guts evolving
in all these gadgets around us.

Meanwhile there is plenty of new projects to work on as Medicine evolves:)
And plenty environment to preserve for the future as the Economy evolves:)
Niether pays that well easily.

Maybe eventually there will be enough contingant against the system
but I think TK must have thought that really its impossible to stop
and that really he just wanted to chat a bit like we have wanted to.

I hope thats gutsy enough to keep AFU running.
